index c7904a4..1a9555f 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,11 @@
+openssh (1:8.2p1-4ubuntu0.4) focal; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/p/match-host-certs-w-public-keys.patch: Add patch
+    to match host certificates agianst host public keys.
+    (LP: #1952421 
+
+ -- Chloé S <chloe.smith@canonical.com>  Thu, 02 Dec 2021 22:38:52 +0000
+
 openssh (1:8.2p1-4ubuntu0.3) focal; urgency=medium
 
   * d/systemd/ssh@.service: preserve the systemd managed runtime directory to
diff --git a/debian/patches/match-host-certs-w-public-keys.patch b/debian/patches/match-host-certs-w-public-keys.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..2f4d509
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/match-host-certs-w-public-keys.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+Description: Match host certificates against host public keys
+ not private keys. Allows use of certificates with private keys
+ held in a ssh-agent.
+Origin: upstream
+Bug: https://bugzilla.mindrot.org/show_bug.cgi?id=3254
+Bug-Ubuntu: https://bugs.launchpad.net/ubuntu/+source/openssh/+bug/1952421
+Forwarded: not-needed
+Applied-Upstream: https://github.com/openssh/openssh-portable/commit/530739d4
+
+From 530739d42f6102668aecd699be0ce59815c1eceb Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
+From: "djm@openbsd.org" <djm@openbsd.org>
+Date: Sun, 6 Jun 2021 11:34:16 +0000
+Reported by Miles Zhou in bz3524; ok dtucker@
+OpenBSD-Commit-ID: 25f5bf70003126d19162862d9eb380bf34bac22a
+
+---
+ sshd.c | 4 ++--
+ 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)
+
+--- a/sshd.c
++++ b/sshd.c
+@@ -1896,7 +1896,7 @@
+ 		/* Find matching private key */
+ 		for (j = 0; j < options.num_host_key_files; j++) {
+ 			if (sshkey_equal_public(key,
+-			    sensitive_data.host_keys[j])) {
++			    sensitive_data.host_pubkeys[j])) {
+ 				sensitive_data.host_certificates[j] = key;
+ 				break;
+ 			}
diff --git a/debian/patches/series b/debian/patches/series
index b5b84a9..0d109af 100644
--- a/debian/patches/series
+++ b/debian/patches/series
@@ -25,3 +25,4 @@ conch-old-privkey-format.patch
 revert-ipqos-defaults.patch
 lp-1876320-upstream-Do-not-call-process_queued_listen_addrs-for.patch
 CVE-2021-28041.patch
+match-host-certs-w-public-keys.patch
